Can't sleep again. The light is on in the kitchen and I told them to leave it off. I keep hearing the song in my head, the new one, and I know if I get up I'll be in the booth till dawn. I have not taken the pills in nine days. I feel sharper without them. Sharper. I see things people don't see. They don't get it. They didn't get it when I ran either.

Studio till four. The Yeezy team wants samples by Friday and I told them I'd have something better than samples I'd have a religion. They laughed. I wasn't joking. K is texting again about the kids and the school thing in Calabasas, I'll deal with it tomorrow. The ranch in Cody is the only place my head is quiet.

I am the only one in this room and that is the way it has always been. Mom used to say I was chosen and she was right and the doctors who put me on the lithium were trying to dim the light. I am not going back on it.

Three days no sleep. I feel incredible. I wrote eleven songs. I called my lawyer at midnight and told him to draft something, I'll explain later. The presidential thing in 2020 was just the warm up everyone will see.
Crashed. Slept twenty hours. Woke up and the room was dark and I couldn't remember what day. The publicist made me take half a tablet. I let her, this once.
Cody. Quiet. Took the full dose tonight. Hate that I had to.

The studio is empty which is when I do my real work. I have the new chair frame on the bench, the one for the Marc Newson collaboration, and I've been staring at the joint where the back meets the seat for two hours. There is something wrong with it that I cannot name. Steve would have named it in eight seconds. I keep wanting to text him and remembering.

My therapist asked me last Tuesday whether I am still defining myself by a building in Cupertino I haven't worked in for seven years. I told her I left in 2019 and started LoveFrom because I wanted to be free of it. She asked me to consider whether I am free of it. I did not have a good answer.

My mum used to call me from Chingford when I was at Newcastle Polytechnic and ask if I was eating. I miss being asked that. I am sixty next year. I wonder sometimes if the thirty years was the work or whether the work was him and I was the hand. The therapist would tell me that is a thought, not a fact. I know. I still think it.

Worked on the King Charles coronation invite font tonight. Marc is in town next week. I want to show him something I am proud of and I am not sure I have anything I am proud of from this calendar year.
Better night. The chair joint resolved itself in a sketch at 1 AM, the way they always do. The trick is to stop trying.
Saw my therapist on Friday. We talked about grief, again. She said I am allowed to grieve a working relationship the way one grieves a person. I have not stopped thinking about that sentence.
Up. Inbox first — 1,840 overnight, mostly the Asia and EMEA ops desks. Cleared to 200 by 4:35. Treadmill 4:50–5:35, easy 6.0 mph, listened to a podcast on the EU AI Act. Showered, oatmeal.
Board call ran long. Tim from finance asked about the Vision Pro Q2 number a third time. I gave the same answer the third time. Discipline.

On the way back from the Park Avenue dinner. Lisa Jackson came with me — she handles it well, the room. I do not handle it as well as the press thinks. The thing nobody tells you about the chair is that the second you sit in it your private life stops being your private life. The Auburn graduation speech is in two weeks. I will write it on Saturday morning, on the porch, like the others. The team will rewrite it on Saturday afternoon and I will rewrite their rewrite on Sunday and we will land somewhere.
Therapist call at 7:45 (phone, drove home from the Park). She asked, again, whether I have anyone in my life I can be unguarded with. I gave the same answer. She is patient with me.

I slept again with the lights on. The boys came over Saturday and they always leave the kitchen one on for me. I won't say I need it but I will say I sleep when it is on and I do not sleep when it is off. After thirteen years of someone else deciding when I sleep and what I take I will keep my kitchen light on.
Filmed two TikToks. Posted one. Deleted the other after my publicist saw it. She said it would 'invite a narrative.' I said maybe I want to invite a narrative. She said please not today. Fine.

My dad's lawyer's name came up in a notification today. I closed the phone and didn't open it again until 9pm. I made the boys mac and cheese. I do not eat mac and cheese but I made it and watched them eat. That is what a Wednesday is now.
They put me on so many things between 2008 and 2021 and now when the Lumen app suggests I should 'consider a sleep aid' I close the app for a week. I closed the app for a week.
Cancelled the Lumen subscription on the 11th, downgraded only, kept the device because the boys gave it to me. I don't want them watching my sleep. I have had enough people watch my sleep.
Wrote 1,200 words on the new draft. Noah was up with the baby till 11. I took the 11–2 shift then sat at the desk till 3:40. The toddler will be up at 6:20 like clockwork.

I keep thinking about a line I had in the Barbie press tour about 'the relentless pleasing.' I said it eighty times and the eighty-first time I almost cried on a German breakfast show. Postpartum has taken that line and made it about the baby. I love the baby. I am also tired in a way the prescription pad does not fully reach.
Refilled the Lexapro at the Park Slope CVS. The pharmacist recognized me — she said she 'loved Lady Bird,' which is sweet. I said thank you and got out fast. Noah was waiting with the stroller.
The new script wants to be about a mother who disappears for an afternoon and comes back. I wonder if my agent will let me write it. I wonder if I will let me write it.
Up with the baby 12:40, 2:10, 3:30. Wrote between feedings. 600 words on the disappearance scene. They are bad. I know they are bad. Tomorrow they may be less bad.
Greta-from-three-years-ago would not believe Greta-now is writing about disappearing mothers. Greta-now thinks Greta-from-three-years-ago should mind her business.

Inking the Penguin cover till 1, then I lay on the floor with the lights off because the brief from the editor came back with 'softer? more inviting?' and softer-more-inviting is not what the book is about. The book is about a woman who burns down her own house. I will not make it inviting.

Couldn't sleep. Got up. Made tea. The flat in Lekki is loud at night, the generator next door cycles every forty minutes, I have stopped noticing it most nights and tonight I notice it. My head is loud in the way my head gets when I haven't talked to anyone for two days. I haven't talked to anyone for two days.
Slept till 1pm. The Penguin job is overdue. Texted my therapist's WhatsApp to move the Wednesday session to Thursday — she said yes. She always says yes. I do not know what I would do without her.

The thought came back. The one where I'm walking across the Lekki-Ikoyi bridge and I imagine, just for a second, what it would be to climb the railing. I do not want to climb the railing. The thought just visits, like a guest who never knocks. I told my therapist about it last month. She said the thought visiting is not the same as the thought meaning anything. I think about that a lot.
Sent the cover to Penguin. They will ask for revisions. I will do them at 2 AM.
Went out for jollof. Saw a person I used to know. Came home. The flat was quiet in the bad way.
Tennis with Roger at 5:45 sharp on the Central Park courts. Roger is dreadful at tennis. I am only marginally better. We do not say a word the entire hour. It is the best part of my day.
Steak at lunch as usual. Andre cut my hair this morning between tennis and the office, the bob looks the same as it has looked since 1988 and that is the point.

Took half a Lunesta. The Met Gala is in eleven days and the dread starts about now. People assume I enjoy the Met Gala. People assume a great many things. The dread is not about the gala itself, the dread is about the eleven days before the gala, when every designer with a phone number wants ten minutes and every editor on the masthead wants fifteen, and Bob is calling about the September issue, and the only hour of the day that is mine is 5:45 to 6:45 in the park, with Roger, in silence.
Took the full Lunesta. It is gala week. I can be precious about pharmaceuticals in June.

Just got home from the overnight at the warehouse. Boys are asleep on the couch, neither one made it to the bed. Microwaved the leftover Whataburger. I will not get to bed before 3. Alarm at 6:20 for school drop. This is the Tuesday-Wednesday rotation, it'll be like this till I find the second-shift retail thing that pays as much, which is never, because no second-shift retail thing pays as much.

Cancelled the Lumen subscription back on March 29 but the device still works in some kind of free trial. I do not know how long. I will not pay $14.99 a month to be told my sleep is poor. I know my sleep is poor.

The 9-year-old asked me yesterday if I was sad. I said I was just tired. He said okay but then he hugged me longer than usual. I sat in the car after the school drop and cried for the length of one song on the radio and then drove to the rideshare zone.

Between the rideshare app and the warehouse it was 19 hours yesterday. The math does not work. I am moving us into my sister's place at the end of the month. The fourth apartment of the year was the last.

Sometimes when I am at the wheel between fares I think about how easy it would be to just keep driving past the next pickup, past the city, just keep driving. I would never do it. The boys are at school. But I think about it.
Closed at 2, walked home, three Old Fashioneds in me from the post-shift round with Marco. Marco's wife is having a baby. Mine is having a wedding. To someone else. Funny.

Same. Three Old Fashioneds, two on the house from Marco, one from a regular who tipped me a hundred dollars on a forty dollar tab and asked if I'd ever thought about modeling, which I had not, at forty-one, ever.

It crosses my mind sometimes when I'm walking home. That if the Bronco coming up Biltmore just clipped me and I just didn't wake up, none of the Tuesday stuff would have to happen. I don't want it to happen. I want to want things again. There is a difference.
Cancelled Lumen on April 2. The device's free-trial period is apparently still on. Whatever. I do not need a $300 nightstand telling me I drink too much.
Sister came by the bar tonight and stayed for one. She said I should call Mom. I said I would. I will not.
Sleeping in the cab tonight at the Flying J in Lordsburg NM. 11 hours of driving today, another 11 tomorrow. Took the trazodone.

Trucker thoughts. Long stretch of I-10 east of El Paso, nothing to look at, you start thinking about the divorce. I think about the divorce a lot. I think about how the only thing I built in 52 years was a house in Bakersfield she now lives in with the new guy. I do not feel sorry for myself out loud. Out loud I am fine.
Took the trazodone. Two now. I know what the bottle says. The bottle does not drive a truck for 11 hours.
There's a stretch of I-10 between Van Horn and Sierra Blanca where the median dips and the Bronco starts to drift if you let off. Sometimes I think about not correcting. I always correct. So far.

Downgraded the Lumen subscription on April 14. The device is in the cab. I keep it because it tells me I slept five hours when I think I slept three, and that is sometimes the difference between getting back behind the wheel and not.

Run, 5K, 24:50. Better than yesterday. Showered, oatmeal, opened the laptop at 6:40 to apply to two more roles. The Capital One staff role and the US Bank principal role. Cover letters were the same paragraph swapped at the top.

Therapist switched. Old one moved out of network. New one is at the Park Nicollet on Lake Street, first session was Friday. Talked about the layoff in October. Six months in and I still feel it like it was yesterday. She said grief is grief, even for a job. Six months. People at church think I'm 'taking time' on purpose.
Bumped the Lexapro from 10 to 15 with the new therapist. Two weeks she said. The old dose was working until the second round of US Bank rejected me without an interview.

The Capital One recruiter sent a Calendly link. Phone screen Tuesday. Ran 8K to celebrate, came back, ate pasta, opened the spreadsheet to log the application. 67 applications since November. 4 phone screens. Math.
Defense in 19 days. Wrote committee responses till 1. Stopped because my hands were shaking again, the way they shake when I forget to take the Adderall on a normal schedule, which I did, today.
Panic attack at the desk around 11:30. Lasted maybe twenty minutes. The breathing thing the university therapist taught me actually worked tonight. Not always. Tonight.

University Health 4pm. Weekly. Talked about the panic attack. She asked about the Adderall schedule. She asked if I have considered, again, that the Adderall is what is causing the panic at night. I said yes. I will not stop the Adderall before the defense. We both know that.

The triple-decker is loud after midnight when both roommates are home. I worked at the kitchen table till one because the desk was too quiet and the kitchen has the white noise of two people who do not know I am awake.
Downgraded Lumen on the 18th. Cannot afford the full subscription on the stipend. The free tier still gives me sleep duration which is what I need to know whether I can function for the day.
My advisor sent edits at 11pm. Of course he did. I will read them at 8 AM with coffee, not at 11 PM with Adderall, this is a rule I am trying to keep.
